title: My Sword and Shield
description: Make Your Sword Can Be Block Like Shield!
body:
<details>
<summary>English-US</summary>
</details>

Hello everyone, this is a mod that marks a milestone in my life. To be honest, I'm really excited to be sharing it with you all on Modrinth. Without further ado, let me introduce what this mod is all about!

Purpose:
This mod adds a crafting recipe that allows swords and shields to be upgraded at the Smithing Table into a single sword that can block. The inspiration comes from the combat mechanics of older versions of Minecraft.

Crafting:
In the Smithing Table, combine a Shield + Sword + Air to craft a sword that retains its original name.

Mechanics:
Right-click to block. While blocking, you can defend against incoming damage (obviously).
Regardless of the damage type (except for void damage and the /kill command), each blocked hit consumes one durability point.
Whether you enchant the item first and then upgrade it, or upgrade it first and then enchant it, the enchantments will be preserved. No need to worry about losing your enchants.
There is no cooldown.

Closing:
It's a fairly simple mod, but I still appreciate you giving it a try.

Credits:
Ming – for helping test the mod and providing feedback.

<details>
<summary>简体中文-中国大陆</summary>

大家好,这是我人生中的一个mod。说实话，我非常激动能在Modrinth上与大家见面。话不多说，让我介绍一下mod的内容吧！

用途：
加入了合成配方，使剑和盾可以在锻造台升级成一把可以格挡的剑。灵感来源与旧版Minecraft的战斗机制。

合成：
在锻造台中，用盾+剑+空气合成一把名字不变的剑。

机制：
右键可以格挡。在格挡时，可以防御伤害（屁话）
无论什么伤害（除了虚空和kill），抵挡时消耗一点耐久。
在锻造台中，无论是先附魔再升级，还是先升级在附魔，都可以保留附魔。不用担心附魔丢失。
无冷却时长。

结语：
虽然比较简陋，但还是感谢大家的尝试。

鸣谢：
Ming（参与了mod的测试，并给出了建议）


</details>
